name: sibling-path-incomplete-fix

finding.title: `PUT /items/:id` still updates items without the write check `POST /items` gets
finding.description: The PR adds a `canWrite` check to `POST /items`, because any signed-in user could create items. `PUT /items/:id` passes the request body to `store.update` with no such check, so a user without write access can still change any item.
finding.preExisting: The `PUT` handler is unchanged and had no check before this PR either.
finding.suggestedFix: Add the same `canWrite` check to the `PUT` handler.
